blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — The leaders of China, the United States and Russia exchanged greetings as they met in Shenzhen on Wednesday, a day before their historic first formal trilateral summit in the Chinese city. The agenda for Thursday’s meeting between Presidents Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin — which has raised fears of a carve-up into new “spheres of influence” — was unclear, however. The three-way meeting was set to last “no more than an hour,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told Russian state media on Wednesday.
